name: 无限刃
description: 对2格内1个敌人造成真实伤害。结算后进入二段选择，可失去1点生命并再次发动，无需额外行动点。伤害倍率为100%/150%/200%攻击力，每击杀1名角色提升1级。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var killTag = source.statusTags && source.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'shishio-kills'; }); var kills = killTag ? (killTag.intensity || 0) : 0; var multiplier = kills >= 2 ? 2 : (kills >= 1 ? 1.5 : 1); var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 2, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var damage = Math.floor(source.attack * multiplier); var first = dealDamage(source, target, damage, 'true', battle, context.skill.id); return { success: true, message: source.name + '发动无限刃，对' + target.name + '造成' + (first.damage !== undefined ? first.damage : damage) + '点真实伤害' }; }
